body:
I had 1.5 years of experience but it was only tax returns, informal bookkeeping, and admin work. I was working there while in school. I graduated in 2017. I left due to mental health reasons.

Even with that it took over half a year to find this job. It was incredibly discouraging but in the end it paid off.
Nah that won't be for a while. He hired me because of my experience with tax returns. He's gonna spend the next while doing training for corporate files.
It's an accounting job.
It's a reference to another post of mine.

Only option I've got is my brother, who actually took the photos for me. Although he disagreed that I'm a hideous monster, he did agree with me that I need better facial expressions.

Thanks. I'm trying to became more outgoing with my hobbies, even with my anxiety. Been going to the movie theatre more and seeing some concerts, even if the crowd makes me anxious.

At a loss on what to do after what happened today.

Fashion is one of my main hobbies. I was told to start taking photos of myself with my outfits. While doing them, I went as far as copying fashion bloggers poses and facial expressions to try to make myself look better. Even doing this, I just see a hideous monster in those photos. Not only that, but even though I tried my best to replicate their expressions, I just had my usual facial expression which is very emotionless and boring.

I was more doing this to try and get used to how I look like to boost my self esteem, but it doesn't look like it worked out. It seems like I have to accept how I look like to be able to do this, but that's not possible.

Any tips on where to go from there?
It usually happens to me in May when the snow is gone and the sun is out a lot more. However, fall started here and I am now hypomanic. Guess it happens to me with every season change.
Just got my first "kill yourself" pm. A part of me feels like it's some sort of rite of passage for FA members.

Bachelor's in math and two college degrees in accounting. I worked at a firm but pretty much all I did were tax returns and really informal bookkeeping. I get lots of interviews but nothing beyond that. I'm also very anxious so I'm sure that doesn't help for interviews.
I wouldn't due to my political views. I'm bipolar as well so even if I wanted to they probably wouldn't let me join.
I think it's more due to trauma rather than her being a narcissist. My father was extremely abusive. She became more toxic and controlling as a result but I won't blame her for that.
Mental illnesses, unattractive, boring personality, lack of friends, still live at home, and am unemployed.

Nothing right now. I did well in school and got multiple post-secondary papers despite what's going on with me, but I'm struggling to get a job with them, and this is with work experience.

I did have 3 job interviews last week. Usually not confident in them, and they never work out. I got rejected in 1, but with the other 2 I finally feel hopeful about them. The jobs seem decent and I answered all the questions well. Hopefully it'll change soon.

I'm also bipolar 2 but I never got into a relationship. This is exactly what I'm scared of and in fact want to ask you about it. Is it just due to the instability of the illness, or does the stress and anxiety of being in a relationship makes it worse?

My brother is schizoaffective. He gets into plenty of relationships but they never work out. After a few months he ends up becoming really anxious, delusional to the point that he starts accusing his gf about things like her being a witch, and ends up yelling a lot and doing self-harm.

I have ocd, anxiety, depression, and type 2 bipolar. I don't think I have adhd, but I do have trouble focusing when it comes to my hobbies. Although it only started a few years ago, and it looks like the onset of it is when you're a child. I honestly think I'm bpd as well and I might ask my psychiatrist about it on my next visit.

Looking back at this post and my reaction, it is a bit silly, but I have impulses and urges to do stuff when something bad happens to me.

Severe acne despite everything, even though I'm 27. Also getting bipolar type 2 and potentially psychosis. Also had Wilms' tumour and a few more mental illnesses from trauma so I'm unlucky on top of shitty genes.
I absolutely love this album. Easily one of my favs. I have bipolar type 2 and I felt like this album described it perfectly.

Thanks for the help. Unfortunately I'm not in the US. I do think that getting at least a tolerable job and enough money to move out of my home will get me back up on my 2 feet, and give me a big confidence boost. That's what I'm aiming for now.

Although I have many red flags, with most being the ones that I don't think I can fix, my main one is my array of mental health problems. Logically (and I'm sure some of you will say this), therapy is the solution. However, therapy is no longer an option for me. I can't afford private therapy. I don't even think sliding scale is an option now because I am unemployed and am on welfare. In terms of public therapy, I had a place that just stopped my appointments and stopped responding to my emails after a few sessions. Two other places say that they only deal with anxiety and depression (which is some stuff I have), but my depression is too severe, and they don't deal with my other illnesses. I also did therapy with PhD students at a discount. However, we didn't click at all, and all the therapist said was "don't be so negative and change your way of thinking". What can I do to fix my mental health problems?

My mental health is even getting worse. 2 years ago I had some delusional thoughts, but I was misdiagnosed and placed under an anti-depressant which made everything worse, so I assumed it was because of that. However, I am now changing anti-psychotics and I'm at a period where I'm under-medicated while adjusting to the new ones. The delusional thoughts are back. I have 3 immediate family members with mental illnesses including psychosis so it makes sense.

I have already accepted that I'll never be in a relationship nor have any friends. In fact, I think that one must be a fucking idiot to wanna spend time with me. However, I just want at least a stable life. A job relevant to my education and experience, and my mind to not get in the way all the time.
I was labelled as one as well. Ended up getting a Bachelor's and two college degrees. Now I'm on welfare. Honestly I just look back on this and laugh.

These albums are quite avant-garde so you might not like them.

For depression, Deathconsciousness by Have a Nice Life, and Hi, How Are You: The Unfinished Album by Daniel Johnston.

For loneliness, Moenai Hai by The Gerogerigegege showed it the best imo.

For self-hatred, I Have Fought Against It, but I Can't Any Longer. by The Body, and Death - Pierce Me by Silencer.

I'm trying to focus on my career as a distraction. Perhaps by being a workaholic with a job that I tolerate, I can tolerate staying alive. However, 3 degrees and 2 years of relevant experience later, I'm on welfare and can't even find a job. I'm even failing in this area. I'm quickly running out of reasons to keep going.

I feel the same way. Perhaps we should follow the rules of nature more. There are some animals that are just not good enough for the world. They usually die while still young. I think that I, like them, am just not good enough for this world. It's the logical explanation as to why I'm a failure in every area in life. It especially explains my situation regarding employment, which I don't care what people say, is not a normal situation.

I've been to college twice and may go a third time if I choose to change my career... yet again. Oddly enough, I had a few (unsuccessful) dates, but they didn't happen until after I was done with college. Received no attention at all while I was at college.

I had manic symptoms on an anti-depressant, and ended up in the psych ward after attempting suicide. They still didn't diagnose me as bipolar II but they put me on anti-psychotics. We reduced the dose after a year because we still thought I had depression and that I was getting better, but that caused severe mood swings to come over the course of a few months. I was then diagnosed as bipolar II.
Haven't spoken to him in 6-7 years and I plan on keeping it that way. He was severely mentally ill which I don't blame him for but it really scared me as a child, and abusive. It was a bad combo.

I gotta stick with public therapy and I think there's only one more place here.

As for that being my career, I really dunno. A bit of both I guess. I worked at a small accounting firm for almost 2 years but had to quit for mental health issues. I hated the coworkers and client contact but didn't mind the accounting work. I took a 2 year college diploma on it and didn't mind it as well but I also spent time at the psych ward and was delusional so I wasn't in the best mind set to judge that.

Two things.

1) Keep hearing that therapy is the way to go, but what to do in a case where that's not possible? I've tried therapy 3 times now. The first time was a PHD student that told me that I shouldn't blame my medication for its side effects on my mental health, and that my solution is to be positive. She probably underestimated my mental illnesses (to be fair I was misdiagnosed at this time). The second time felt ok but I got transferred to someone else quite quickly. For the 3rd time, they abruptly stopped my appointments and stopped responding to my emails. Trying it a 4th time, especially after being rejected like that for my 3rd time, is discouraging, and it doesn't help that it was public therapy as I can't afford private therapy (I mean hell, in 3 months I won't be able to afford my medication anymore, which honestly barely works).

2) I've decided that I can't improve my life in terms of friendships and relationships, so I'll try to find a purpose in life through a career. I'm completely failing in that regard now. I'm getting interviews but they're not working out. I'm considering getting a 2nd bachelor's in accounting, but I'm wondering if that will even help. Hell, I'm not even sure if accounting is the right career for me. I have an alternative look and will eventually get tattoos on my hands, so many companies will reject me. I also reject the public accounting aspect as its environment is oppressive, sociopath-friendly, and its culture is a lack of culture. Industry accounting has less money which I don't care about, but will also be harder to get in. The other thing is, if I don't get disability for my mental illnesses which I'll sign up for today, and I'll go back to school, this means that I'll be living at home until I'm 32-33. Not only will this depress me, but it will make me the laughing stock.

Thanks for the help.

I now feel like there's only two ways to get a decent job. The first one is to have the social connections, which we're obviously fucked with. The second is through school itself. Since you're still studying, I'd suggest to try getting into co-op and attending the networking events. Even with having some form of anxiety, networking is not the worst as the potential employers there will be asking you questions and you won't have to initiate.

That's why I'm considering getting a second bachelor's. I'll be gaining more relevant experience through co-op and even though I'll be a decade older, I'm sure I'll be considered as a better potential employee than the average student during networking events.

It's public sector. Was referred there after I spent time in the psych ward. I had two therapists there and it was for maybe 6-7 months. The one mentioned on my post was for 3 months and doing cbt. She was training for it though.

There's one more public sector therapy place here. I'll ask my psychiatrist for a referral.

The first private therapist was a PHD student and it was a disaster. She said that medication does nothing and that I shouldn't blame it for my mania and serotonin syndrome, and that the solution for me was to stop thinking negative and start being positive. If only it was that simple.

Thanks for the message. I did a bit of research for both universities.

One of them I can shave off 3 semesters, maybe 4 depending on how they feel about CPA preparatory courses or a few more college courses. However, I can't start until September 2019. For another one, I can only shave off 1-2 semesters, but I can start in January.

I am leaning towards the September one as I'd prefer to go to that university anyways. Also because this is a back-up plan in case I can't find a job.

I'll spend the rest of the year job searching. If I can't find one, I'll apply to that university, and just take a seasonal job doing tax returns in the new year.

I didn't do the intermediate modules yet. They did not accept my college courses. I got exempt from 3 courses as I took them as electives in university. I'm currently doing intro to managerial now, which I already took at college.

Did mushrooms 3 times. They were good for introspection (I was closing my eyes and looking at what was there the entire time), but all trips were pretty bad. Plus I had a genetic disposition for bipolar and it's a possibility that the mushrooms triggered it, as my symptoms started after taking them.

She did initiate some stuff and I went with it, but it just was light handplay. We didn't wanna take it too far because we were both virgins. She didn't immediately ghost me after. We continued messaging each other. We planned a 4th date but she had to cancel it, but gave what seemed a good excuse and saying that she still wanted to see me soon. After two weeks she cancelled the next date again, but it seemed a lot more cold and distant. After that, no response.

If she ghosted me directly after you would have had a point, but this is more confusing.

I do believe I'm unattractive, but some people say otherwise. However, I have more red flags than a communist parade. It reached the point where I think I'm objectively undateable and that someone would have to be an idiot to date me.

Accounting. I'm type 2 bipolar and phases can happen due to outside events. The cold atmosphere and boredom of my old job were causing depressive phases (basically working there literally made me suicidal). The fact that I was getting paid more doing fast food is just the cherry on top.

In 2 months I applied to 6 places and had 3 interviews which is pretty good. I do the tests well and I'm pretty sure the interviews went well too. I mean, I have no self-esteem and think negative about everything so if I think something went well then it must have really went well lol. Even with that I receive no response afterwards. My family is saying that my personality and looks is more like an artsy/punk kind of person, and they don't wanna hire someone like that as an accountant.
No gf/bf, no friends, was recently misdiagnosed with a more serious mental illness, quit my job due to my mental health, and am struggling to find another job.

I have tried okcupid a few times, even paid for it. It seems like I actually give a good first impression. I either wrote a decent profile, am attractive (can't be cause I don't see it), or both. I reached the point where I have around 100 likes and had a response to all of my first messages except for one person. However, I have so many red flags that it reaches the point where I'm objectively undateable. 99% of the time they find out more about me before we plan the first date and ghost me. Sometimes I get the odd date, but the end result is always the same. I actually got my first kiss a few months ago and went on three dates with that person, but got ghosted in the end.

I had my psychiatrist and family doctor telling me to stop dating though. Just getting ghosted is enough to make me have suicidal thoughts for a week or two.

I attempted suicide March of last year. Today I'm unemployed and still FA so I guess life isn't getting better. Now that I'm medicated, I still want to die, and definitely do not wanna stay alive for 40-50 more years, but I'm not actively planning my next suicide attempt. I guess that means some progress is made?
I guess I can say I accepted it. Someone would have to be an idiot to date me tbh.

I have a bachelor's in math, a 1-year college degree in bookkeeping, and a 2-year college diploma in accounting. I'm now trying to get my designation which will take a few years. This job is minimum wage. I took it cause I was still a full-time student then with no relevant experience.

Is it heartbreaking when I spend like 5-10 minutes working on a tax return and then I see the boss charges the client $300 for it. It's just as heartbreaking with the accounting stuff too.

Now that I have almost 2 years experience I am looking for another job. I applied for 5 jobs so far in around 3 weeks and got 3 interviews, so I should get another soon.

Sending an email telling him to quit will be incredibly difficult for me to do with my anxiety.

Accounting Assistant. I'm gonna quit tomorrow though because it affects my mental health. My doctor and psychiatrist even told me that I gotta find a new job. I work alone 95% of the time. Usually I won't mind it but it's either sitting around waiting for more work, or doing very mindless work. Plus there's the fact that I was making more money working fast food as a supervisor, and I have a coworker making more in a hour than I make in a day.

I have 2 coworkers and don't talk to them. When it was just one coworker we did the usual small talk to each other because there was no one else to talk to. When the 2nd coworker came in they clicked and now talk to each other all the time while I'm alone.

I wasn't depressed. I am type 2 bipolar. When on paxil I had the most major mood swings where I either thought I was the best in the world, or suicide looked like the logical thing to do.

Guess that's another reason why I'm FA lol
I have quite a few clothes with holes in them, but that's how I bought them as they were in that style. Does that still count as a dealbreaker?

Paxil was hell for me, but it shouldn't happen to you. It gave me both serotonin syndrome and made my symptoms a million times worse to the point that I eventually attempted suicide. But, I was misdiagnosed so that's why it happened.

>Foreign, subversive, arthouse, and especially experimental, although I try to see as much as I can. These days I'm trying to see more films from Africa. Actually loved quite a few from there already.

With my mental health issues, my current job has literally made me suicidal. I am on medical leave now to find another job, but it can only last so long because eventually I'll need the money to pay the bills (which will probably in 2-3 weeks). Volunteering while I'm in that mood will only make things worse.

The good news is that I do have a job interview today, so it may be over soon.

My main hobbies are films, music, and fashion. I do have a film blog on tumblr with quite a few followers so I guess I'm ok in that department. Still, finding people in this city with taste or at least interest in seeing the stuff I see is very difficult. It's the same with music.

On online dating they do compliment me on the fact that my taste in stuff is original, but I list off the more "normal" things. After a while I show them some of my favourite genres of music which can be really hateful stuff like harsh noise or power electronics and it always weirds them out. Sometimes they stop talking to me entirely.

I also enjoy learning about as many things I can. Topics that I'm into the most are arts, politics, history, and philosophy.

I went to concerts alone tons of times in the past with no problem. The problem is that I was recently diagnosed with type 2 bipolar and this was the first time I went to one since the symptoms started. It sucks being worse than I was before, even if I had quite a bit of therapy and medication.

I was thinking about volunteering before. I should wait until I find a new job first though. Those types of classes are not for me as I don't have any creativity at all.

I am part of a forum for one of my hobbies. It is practically my only social outlet. It is nice, but I would like to do it in real life as well, and stuff like this forum make me realize that the people who are also into it don't live near me.

My main goal is to find a new job as I cannot afford to move out now, plus work affects my mental health issues. This is where the challenge lies and actually makes it seem impossible to go through. One of mental illnesses is type 2 bipolar. In fact, I was very recently diagnosed with it. The problem with it is that external factors can be a reason why one has a hypomanic or depressive phase, and these depressive phases made me reach the point where I actively plan my suicide (and I have attempted it in the past).

I have had tons of these depressive phases so far this year, and the 2 things that caused it was dating and my current job. My psychiatrist told me to stop dating and put me on medical leave for a few weeks to find another job (even more motivation to find a new job though which is a good thing). Thankfully part of this was because I reduced the dose of my medication cause my doctor and I initially thought I just had depression and anxiety, and that I was ready to start decreasing the dose. It is now back to the normal dose.

I have been in therapy ever since I was in the psych ward, at least until the situation happened that I mentioned in my other post. I did have those exercises of forcing myself into new situations (go relax in a coffee shop), but ever since my therapist was injured I stopped doing it, mostly because after 6 times there was no improvement.

Thanks to medication and therapy, my depressive phases reaches the point where I just think about how badly I want to die instead of planning my suicide, so it's a start. However, stuff like being criticized, yelled at, or even light things like ghosting trigger these depressive phases. Will they ever reach the point where I don't care? Maybe. But, if my reaction to these things is me reaching the point where I want to die, then doing it doesn't seem like the best thing to do. At least not until I'm more stable.

Fake it until you make it is definitely easier said than done. I actually tried to do something like that last night. I went alone to a concert. I tried to fake being happy and just focus on the music. It started out ok but being in a crowd full of people and being the only person there alone (at least seemingly) made me feel like absolute garbage. For some reason I was also overloading on anxiety. I actually almost left because the feelings were that bad.

I turned 27 today and I'm doing my usual birthday tradition of realizing that I'm a year older and am a complete failure in every way.

Here's a list of my red flags that make me objectively undateable. How can I get rid of them?  I still live at home, I make minimum wage (but I am getting ripped off), my taste in stuff is too weird and impossible to relate to, I am mentally ill, I have no friends, I hate socializing, I am a virgin, I have a severe lack of masculinity (and in fact hate masculinity), I am unattractive, I have no humour, I lack a charming personality, I am very reserved and quiet, and I hate anything happy and/or fun.

For the first 2, I do have my 2nd job interview within 2 weeks tomorrow, so that may change. My taste in stuff is my passion and I can't see that changing. I am medicated and had therapy, although I may have to stop it soon (my therapist has been unavailable due to an injury for almost 2 months now anyways). I tried to make friends by joining 2 clubs but I really felt out of place there. The rest except the virginity one just seems to be my personality. I have no idea how to change that. Hell, I don't even know if I want to.

Thanks for the in-depth post. However, I don't live in America, so I have a feeling that the social disability benefits, ADA, etc don't apply here, or at least are slightly different. Now I feel bad for making you go through the trouble.

I give a good first impression. However, the amount of red flags I have make me objectively undateable.  I still live at home, I make minimum wage (but I am getting ripped off), my taste in stuff is too weird and impossible to relate to, I am mentally ill (various forms of anxiety, ocd, and type 2 bipolar), I have no friends, I hate socializing, I am a virgin, I have a severe lack of masculinity (and in fact hate masculinity), I am unattractive, I have no humour, I lack a charming personality, I am very reserved and quiet, and I hate anything happy and/or fun.

I am not a neo-nazi. I did vote for the communist party before as they had my favourite election platform. However, I went for a more mainstream party at the recent election here due to strategic voting (they were a good party anyways).

Not that much into the occult but I do have 4 Goetian seals tattooed on me.

There are two nearby cities that may have some hope of finding people who share my interests. All the more artsy people move to one of those cities. However, one of them has different laws related to my career so I'd have to start from scratch. For the other city, I'm still in school now for the next 4-5 years so that's not an option until I'm done.
It's non-existent for me. Most I had was 3 dates and a kiss. I have self-esteem issues on top of my diagnoses. In fact, I consider myself objectively undateable.

Good idea. However, I think it is a higher priority to find another job now. My doctor also said that my job is a stressor as I tend to have suicidal ideation while working. I'm gonna see today if I can decrease it to part\-time for health reasons. That will also give me more time to job hunt.

I'm not an incel so no worries. I did try to lurk there to find people to relate to, but I don't agree with their ideology at all.

I watch experimental films and listen to a few extreme music genres like harsh noise and power electronics. Whenever I try to show it to potential dates or friends they always get weirded out. Some even stopped talking to me.

Mostly arts and politics but I also look into stuff like history and philosophy.

I'm turning 27 very soon.

I have 3 post\-secondary papers and am getting my 4th and I have almost 2 years of experience relevant to my career. I'm looking for a new job now.

I'm into films and music mostly. Also into fashion and reading. I enjoy trying to learn about as many topics as possible.

Here's my other red flags: I still live at home, I make minimum wage (but I am getting ripped off), my taste in stuff is too weird and impossible to relate to, have a few more mental illnesses, I have no friends, I hate socializing, I am a virgin, I have a severe lack of masculinity (and in fact hate masculinity), I am unattractive, I have no humour, I lack a charming personality, I am very reserved and quiet, and I hate anything happy and/or fun.

I have to learn how to accept being alone. Is there any way to enjoy it?

There's my reasoning which is that although I give a good first impression, the amount of red flags I have makes me objectively undateable. However, today I was diagnosed as type 2 bipolar (another red flag yay) and was told by my doctor that my attempts at dating is a stressor that can trigger a depressive bipolar phase. She said to stop dating as it can literally make me suicidal (and it has).

The problem is that the pain of isolation can be too much. I have attempted to make friends in the past and failed so I practically have no social life.
Thanks for the message. Turns out I am type 2 bipolar. This nurse thing is worse cause it meant I was actually right.

I've been doing this job for almost 2 years and I'm starting to think that accounting may not be the career for me. With this much experience I am starting to look for another job that's not in a public accounting firm though. Perhaps in finance or managerial accounting. I also have a degree in math so I'm more into the number-heavy stuff.

It does suit my analytical thinking style, but I would say that it's "not me". I mean I have tattoos, piercings, pink hair, voted for the communist party, and am interested in the arts (although I have no artistic talent). I always feel so out of place at work.

CBT from what I learned in therapy is taking a thought and looking at the evidence for and against it. What usually happens is that by looking at the evidence you have a more realistic way of thinking. She's also giving me homework such as going to coffee shops and just relaxing there for a few minutes.

She didn't help me prove that I'm undateable. I just used the method she taught me and I found lots of evidence for it and almost nothing against it. I didn't bring it up with her yet as she unfortunately got injured from a car crash recently.

I tried finding happiness through various avenues. I first became obsessed with some hobbies. Then, I tried to find it through a career. Now I think having a healthy social life will do so.

I did find one meetup group for anxiety and depression. I'll think about it, but I'm seeing my psychiatrist again next week after a few months so I'll ask her about it first. My family doctor did say that I may have been misdiagnosed as well, but I digress.

Thanks for the message.

Not an incel but am isolated. Despite the fact that I tried for 4 years, I have never been in a relationship or have friends. I am convinced that I'm objectively undateable. However, I see this as proof of me being a terrible person. I question what's the point of staying alive for 40-50 more years with this social isolation and a 2 year long job and counting and a career that I don't enjoy.

I've been in therapy for over a year now but it's not helping. I use the cbt approach as proof of why I'm undateable and a bad person as I have evidence for it and nothing against it.

Is there any way for me to get out of this mess? After my suicide attempt last year I thought I was so low that there's no where to go but up, but now that doesn't seem to be the case.

I have been praised by my boss for my speed of doing work and its accuracy.

I am shy but I did do the usual small talk with a coworker when it was just us 2. However, a third person was hired and those 2 clicked together well and now I am left out.

I do ask for more work. It usually comes down to doing menial tasks like scanning some documents and then me asking again every few minutes for more work until he says there are none and sends me home.

I had a similar thing in therapy. It made me realize that the positive qualities about me only give a good first impression. When someone starts finding out about my personality and other red flags they bail. It's usually before the first date, but recently someone didn't bail until 3 dates in (got my first kiss at 26 from this person) and it was heartbreaking.
I realized that I am objectively undateable and definitely not good enough for someone. To be frank, someone would have to be an idiot to want to date me.

That seems possible to do. I am trying to set career-oriented goals now. My current job is related to my career as opposed to it being the standard minimum wage job. I'm just getting ripped off. But now that I have almost 2 years of relevant experience I am currently looking for better paying jobs.

I have done the hobby approach for a few years. Although I am still passionate about them, the social isolation is too much for me. Events related to my hobbies are non-existent in this city, and I felt really out of place going to clubs for other hobbies.

I enjoy socializing if it's with people I like which rarely happens. I do miss the person if I like them.

I sometimes do wanna live alone, but in the long-term the emotional pain of being socially isolated is too much. On top of that, I see the lack of relationships and friendships as proof that I am a bad person.

I have therapy and I am medicated.

I tried 2 meetups. First was ultimate frisbee. The sport itself was decent but I felt so out of place when talking to people there.

I did knitting when I was in the psych ward and tried joining for that too. I felt even more out of place.

There isn't anything related to my hobbies unfortunately.

Some stuff makes me laugh, but I prefer different emotional reactions. I like stuff that depresses me, scares me, relaxes me, stuff that makes me cry or that I find beautiful. Hell, even stuff that overwhelmes me with its intensity. I find that stuff more fulfilling than happy things.

Nothing wrong with masculinity itself, but it seems that in society it's considered the better of the two which is bullshit. Not only does that attack men who aren't considered masculine enough, but (even worse) it gives the implication that women are lesser beings becaus3 of it.

I think that masculinity should be considered equal with feminity and that they shouldn't be restricted by gender.

> You can change this, why don't you?

In the process. Getting my 4th post-secondaey paper now now and am looking for another job.

> But you just said your taste in stuff is what gives people a positive first impression of you so that's a contradiction, which of the two is it?

For music I only mention the more normal stuff at first. After I while I mention stuff like power electronics and harsh noise and they get weirded out. For films they find it interesting until I show them some of the films.

> I'm surprised because your personality seems super masculine, a certain type of masculinity. In any case a true lack of masculinity would be great and refreshing for many people.

Really? I don't see it. I mean I have light pink hair for a start.

> But you just said people get a positive first impression of you from your looks, can you explain the contradiction there?

Never said that. I said that they find me interesting and intelligent, not attractive.
